# truefoundry_azure_account (Resource)

Manages a TrueFoundry Azure provider account carrying blob storage integrations, applied as a `provider-account/azure` manifest via `PUT /api/svc/v1/apply`. Azure accounts can also hold AKS, container registry, key vault, and repos integrations — those are not modeled; do not manage a pre-existing account that uses them, an apply would strip them. Existing accounts can be imported by their FQN, e.g. `terraform import truefoundry_azure_account.example my-tenant:azure:my-account`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Azure account with a blob storage container, connection string in Vault.
resource "truefoundry_azure_account" "storage" {
  name            = "my-blobstorage"
  subscription_id = "00000000-1111-2222-3333-444444444444"

  blob_storages = [
    {
      name              = "assets"
      storage_root      = "https://myaccount.blob.core.windows.net/assets/some/prefix"
      connection_string = "my-tenant:hashicorp:vault-secrets:secret-store:vault::blobstorage/myaccount/value"

      authorized_subjects = ["team:everyone"]
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `blob_storages` (Attributes List) Azure Blob Storage containers accessible through this account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--blob_storages))
- `name` (String) Name of the Azure account (3-32 characters, lowercase alphanumeric and hyphens). Changing it replaces the account.

### Optional

- `subscription_id` (String) Azure subscription ID the account belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `fqn` (String) Fully qualified name of the Azure account.
- `id` (String) Control plane ID of the Azure account.

<a id="nestedatt--blob_storages"></a>
### Nested Schema for `blob_storages`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name identifying this blob storage integration.
- `storage_root` (String) Root URL of the storage, e.g. https://myaccount.blob.core.windows.net/mycontainer/some/prefix.

Optional:

- `authorized_subjects` (List of String) Subjects allowed to use this blob storage, as `<user_type>:<username>` FQNs.
- `connection_string` (String, Sensitive) Azure storage connection string. Accepts TrueFoundry secret references (recommended); the control plane returns it as stored, so drift is detected. The control plane verifies credentials at apply time — omitting the connection string only works if the control plane itself has an Azure identity with access to the storage.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Azure accounts are imported by their FQN: <tenant>:azure:<name>.
terraform import truefoundry_azure_account.storage my-tenant:azure:my-blobstorage
```
